pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with irregular, jagged edge gradients. Patches on the upper flank exhibit greater spatial area than those transitioning towards the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Tessellated network of light-colored pathways separating dark patches. Pathways maintain continuity with frequent 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Pixel thickness is non-uniform, narrowing at certain vertex points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible jagged silhouette along the superior neck margin with low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations representing the mane line.

other_distinctive_markers: Two avian commensals (oxpeckers) are perched on the specimen: one on the dorsal ridge of the lower neck and one on the upper lateral neck.
